thesis: CERT is in a strong uptrend and is now pulling back into a defined entry zone after a Q3 earnings beat. Software growth and margins are improving, quarterly net income turned positive, and free cash flow is solid with low dilution risk. Short interest is high, so there is squeeze potential if the post-earnings base holds. The setup is not clean. The regime is neutral and tech-weak, the last session was a bearish reversal, and reward/risk is only moderate. This favors a small, patient pullback entry and not chasing.
